Build a Meta Lead Ads CRM Portal on Stackby instead. Connect Meta Lead Ads with a sync connector and every new lead from your Facebook and Instagram forms lands in your CRM in real time: assigned to a rep, followed up automatically and tracked to revenue.

• Auto-assign and follow-up workflows (speed to lead)

• Live dashboard: leads, cost per lead and revenue per campaign
